builtItems: BrouwerFixedPointOQ02.lean: discrete IVT, approximate fixed points, convergence, contraction, binary search, PPAD, Sperner 1D (0 sorries)
BrouwerFixedPointOQ02Ext.lean: uniqueness, error bound, geometric convergence, combined complexity bound (0 sorries)
BrouwerFixedPointOQ02Stability.lean: perturbation stability, geometric decay, averaged iteration, parametric sensitivity (0 sorries)
insights: Binary search gives optimal O(log 1/eps) for 1D continuous self-maps of [0,1]
Contraction mapping theory gives explicit error bound: eps/(1-L) proximity guarantee
PPAD solution existence proved via path-following + pigeonhole on finite types
Fixed point stability: delta-perturbation of contraction shifts fixed point by at most delta/(1-L)
Krasnoselskii-Mann averaged iteration T_t = (1-t)I + t*f has Lipschitz constant (1-t(1-L))
Parametric sensitivity: K/(1-L) Lipschitz dependence of fixed point on parameter
